description:
SIGN THE PETITION👇 End the 40 year reign of terror. Restore accountability and legal liability to vaccine manufacturers. www.vacsafety.org/petitionShow more Vaccine Injured: A Path to Recovery
What happens when the system that promised safety has no answers when things go wrong?
This week on VSRF Live, we bring you three firsthand accounts of COVID-19 vaccine injury—and the very different paths each of these individuals has taken in search of recovery.
Brittany “Brit” Galvin, a Florida-based professional, saw her life abruptly upended after developing serious health issues following her COVID shot. When her condition was dismissed and meaningful care was out of reach, she turned to her own research and began speaking out—sharing what it means to navigate life after vaccine injury, and what it takes to reclaim it.
Evan George was just 28 years old when his health began to collapse following his Covid shot. A pianist whose life centered around music, he is now largely unable to sit or use his arms, living with a progressive, debilitating condition that has defied conventional diagnosis and treatment. His journey raises urgent questions about underlying mechanisms—far beyond what standard medicine is willing to confront.
Robert “Bob” Benson spent years deteriorating after his COVID booster shot—losing his health, his business, and nearly his life. After exhausting all conventional treatment options, he traveled to Japan for a novel treatment targeting amyloid pathology, dual filtration plasma apheresis (DFPP), led by researcher Kevin McCairn, PhD. The result: rapid and dramatic improvement after years of health decline.
Three stories. Three trajectories. One question:
Why are patients forced to search the world for answers, and why are the most promising treatments happening outside the U.S.?
This is not just a conversation about injury. It’s about new hope for answers.
Join us as we examine the treatments emerging beyond conventional systems, and the growing number of patients who say they’re finally working.
